item.title: Delhi Govt Bans All Firecrackers in Clubs, Bars and Restaurants Ahead of Festive Season.
item.description: Delhi Bans All Firecrackers in Clubs, Bars & Restaurants Ahead of New Year. In a strong preventive step ahead of the Christmas and New Year rush, the Delhi government has imposed a blanket ban on the use of all firecrackers—including electric and so-called “cold pyro” devices—inside clubs, bars, restaurants, hotels and other licensed hospitality venues across the capital, following a deadly nightclub fire in Goa that exposed serious safety lapses. item.title: Ahmedabad sees 12-day waiting period, Surat 18 days for passport services
item.description: Applicants seeking passports are facing a waiting period of 12 days at the Regional Passport Office (RPO) in Ahmedabad, while the wait stretches to 18 days in Surat. At RPO Ahmedabad, the tatkal waiting period has increased over the past two years. It stood at two days in 2023, rose to four days in 2024, and has further increased to five days in 2025. item.title: India to face South Africa in Third T20 at Dharamsala
item.description: In men’s cricket, India will clash against South Africa in the third T20 match of the series at the Himachal Pradesh Cricket Association Stadium in Dharamsala this evening. The 5-match series is currently drawn at 1-1. The fourth match of the series will be played in Lucknow on Wednesday, while the final match is scheduled at the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad on Friday.

item.title: Amazon Kindle’s new in-app AI feature lets users ask questions on books: Report
item.description: Reading on a Kindle may soon become more interactive, with Amazon reportedly introducing a new AI-powered feature that lets users ask and receive answers about the books on their e-readers. The feature, called ‘Ask This Book’, will let users select any passage from a book in their Kindle library and ask questions about the content – all without leaving the page – according to a report by publishing industry magazine PubLunch.
